title: FAQ
description: Frequently Asked Question entry with question, answer, category, display order, helpful votes, view count, and timestamps. Used for help centers, knowledge bases, and customer support documentation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FAQ entry

answer.description: Answer or solution to the question

category.description: FAQ category (e.g., Getting Started, Billing, Technical, Account)

order.description: Display order or sort position in the FAQ list

helpful_count.description: Number of users who found this FAQ helpful

views.description: Total number of times this FAQ has been viewed

created_at.description: Timestamp when the FAQ was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the FAQ was last updated
